06 / A LITTLE CLARITY

Curious?
Let’s talk.

A few answers before your first hello.

What happens at my first visit?

Your first appointment is a chance to discuss your concerns, review your dental history, and have an examination. Your dentist will explain any suggested next steps.

I’m nervous about dental treatment. Can you help?

Let your dentist know before treatment begins. You can discuss your concerns, agree on pauses, and ask for explanations throughout your visit.

How much will my treatment cost?

Costs depend on the treatment and your individual needs. A written estimate should be provided after assessment, before you agree to proceed.

Can I explore whitening or clear aligners?

Yes. Start with a consultation to discuss your goals. Your dentist will assess whether these options are appropriate for your teeth and gums.

Is online booking confirmed immediately?

This is a demonstration website. The booking flow lets you preview an appointment request, but it does not send your details or confirm a real appointment.
